explanation: This slide outlines the subtopics to be discussed in the Fungi unit (6.4): Evolution, Structure, Reproduction, Diversity, and Symbiotic Relationships of Fungi.

questions.q: Which of the following topics is NOT listed on the Fungi Outline slide?
questions.exp: Amoeboid locomotion belongs to the study of protists (Amoebozoa), not Fungi. The outline lists Evolution, Structure, Reproduction, Diversity, and Symbiotic Relationships.
